words.engDef: a full range of products of one kind
words.example: We offer a complete line of office supplies, from pens to printers.
words.chinese: 完整系列產品/服務

words.engDef: cheap enough for people to be able to buy
words.example: We're looking for an affordable supplier of raw materials to reduce production costs.
words.chinese: 價格實惠的；負擔得起的

words.engDef: arrangements that two or more sides accept
words.example: Both parties must sign the agreements before the project can begin.
words.chinese: 協議；合約；諒解

words.engDef: a family name
words.example: Our lab ordered several reagents from Aldrich for the ongoing research project.
words.chinese: 阿爾德里奇（Aldrich）是一家全球知名的化工試劑和精細化學品供應商，主要為科研、製藥、以及其他工業應用提供產品。

words.engDef: put together from separate parts
words.example: The furniture was delivered unassembled, so we had to assemble it ourselves.
words.chinese: 組裝完成的；已組裝好的

words.engDef: of several different types together
words.example: The store offers an assorted selection of teas from around the world.
words.chinese: 各式各樣的；多樣化的

words.engDef: at a price much lower than the usual one
words.example: We're offering the new software at a substantial discount to encourage early adoption.
words.chinese: 以大幅折扣

words.engDef: as fast as possible
words.example: The delivery truck is operating at full speed to meet the tight deadline.
words.chinese: 全速；以最快的速度

words.engDef: an order that cannot be filled until stock arrives
words.example: We have a back order for 500 units of the product due to high demand.
words.chinese: 預訂未交貨的商品，通常是因為供應商缺貨或延遲交貨。

words.engDef: containers made of soft material for carrying things
words.example: The shipping department needs to pack these fragile items in sturdy bags.
words.chinese: 袋子；行李（通常指裝物品的容器或行李箱）

words.engDef: long curved yellow fruit
words.example: The import department needs to confirm the quantity of bananas before placing the order.
words.chinese: 香蕉；（多數情況下指大量香蕉，常與採購、物流相關）

words.engDef: a pattern of lines a machine reads to identify a product
words.example: The cashier scanned the barcode to process the payment quickly.
words.chinese: 一組條碼，通常用於商品識別和庫存管理，包含一系列的條紋和空格，經由掃描器讀取。

words.engDef: to discuss prices in order to reach an agreement
words.example: The purchasing manager had to bargain over prices with the supplier to stay within budget.
words.chinese: 就價格協商；就價格討價還價

words.engDef: discussing terms in order to reach an agreement
words.example: The company is currently bargaining with the supplier to secure a better price for the raw materials.
words.chinese: 議價；協商價格

words.engDef: a long flat boat used for carrying goods on rivers
words.example: The company is shipping the raw materials by barge to reduce transportation costs.
words.chinese: 大型貨船；（尤指）載運貨物的平底船

words.engDef: to exchange goods for other goods without using money
words.example: In some developing countries, companies still barter goods and services instead of using currency.
words.chinese: 以物易物；交換（通常指沒有金錢交易的交換行為）

words.english: be stacked on top of each other
words.engDef: to be placed in a pile one above another
words.example: The boxes were stacked on top of each other to maximize space in the warehouse.
words.chinese: 堆疊在一起；一層層疊放

words.engDef: a detailed list of a shipment given by carrier to consignor as a receipt
words.example: A signed bill of lading is required before the cargo can be released at the port.
words.chinese: 提單

words.engDef: obtained something by paying for it
words.example: The company bought a new server to handle increased website traffic.
words.chinese: 購買；採購

words.engDef: containers with flat sides used for packing goods
words.example: The warehouse staff are responsible for stacking the boxes neatly.
words.chinese: 箱子；容器（通常指大型的、用於運輸或儲存物品的箱體）

words.engDef: damage caused when something is broken
words.example: The shipping department is responsible for minimizing breakage during transit.
words.chinese: 損壞、破壞；（物品的）破損

words.engDef: a shop that sells meat
words.example: Our company sources fresh produce and meat from local butcher's shops to ensure quality.
words.chinese: 肉舖；屠夫店，通常販售肉類、家禽和海鮮。

words.engDef: a person who buys something; also one who buys for a company
words.example: The company is actively seeking new buyers for its products in overseas markets.
words.chinese: 購買者；客戶

words.engDef: people who buy goods, especially for a business
words.example: The company is targeting new buyers in the Asian market.
words.chinese: 購買者；顧客（通常指批量購買或商務交易中的購買者）

words.engDef: obtaining goods by paying for them
words.example: The company is currently buying new equipment to upgrade its production line.
words.chinese: 購買；採購

words.engDef: transported by aeroplane
words.example: The company ships its products by air to ensure timely delivery.
words.chinese: 經由空運；搭乘飛機

words.engDef: paid for using a credit card
words.example: You can pay for the goods by credit card.
words.chinese: 使用信用卡

words.engDef: transports something; also has goods for sale
words.example: The shipping company carries a wide range of goods, including fragile items.
words.chinese: 攜帶；運送；承載

words.engDef: to hold and move a big package
words.example: The delivery service requires customers to carry a large parcel to the designated drop-off point.
words.chinese: 攜帶大型包裹

words.engDef: holding and moving something from place to place
words.example: The shipping company is responsible for carrying the goods safely to the destination.
words.chinese: 攜帶；運送；承載

words.engDef: a person who transports goods by cart
words.example: The logistics manager hired several carters to transport the grain to the warehouse.
words.chinese: 搬運工；運輸工（通常指負責搬運穀物或其他農產品的人）

words.engDef: small vehicles pushed or pulled to carry goods
words.example: The warehouse staff uses carts to move pallets of goods efficiently.
words.chinese: 手推車；貨車（通常指用於運輸貨物的簡單車輛）

words.engDef: a book or list showing goods that can be bought
words.example: The purchasing department is reviewing the latest catalog to identify potential suppliers.
words.chinese: 產品目錄；清單，通常包含商品或服務的詳細描述和價格。

words.engDef: costing less money
words.example: We're looking for a cheaper supplier to reduce our production costs.
words.chinese: 價格更低廉的；較便宜的

words.engDef: costing the least money
words.example: We're looking for the cheapest supplier for these raw materials.
words.chinese: 最便宜的；價格最低的

words.engDef: substances made or used in chemical processes
words.example: The logistics team needs to ensure the safe handling and storage of these hazardous chemicals.
words.chinese: 化學物質；化學品，通常指工業或商業用途的化學成分。

words.engDef: the removing of stock or debts; also an open space
words.example: The warehouse is undergoing a clearing process to make room for new inventory.
words.chinese: 清理；空出；（債務、庫存等）清償

words.engDef: a thin layer covering a surface
words.example: The manufacturer applied a protective coating to the metal components to prevent rust.
words.chinese: 塗層；覆層，通常指用於保護或美化物體的薄層。

words.engDef: a length of rope or wire wound into rings
words.example: The warehouse manager requested a detailed inventory of all copper coils.
words.chinese: 線圈；繞組；捲繞物

words.engDef: able to catch fire and burn easily
words.example: The warehouse manager emphasized the need to store combustible materials away from heat sources.
words.chinese: 易燃的；可燃的，指容易被火焰點燃的物質。

words.engDef: to become no longer firmly fixed
words.example: During shipping, several screws came loose from the equipment, requiring immediate repair.
words.chinese: 鬆脫；脫落（指連接物或零件不再固定）

words.engDef: the trading links between businesses or countries
words.example: Maintaining strong commercial relations with overseas suppliers is crucial for our company's success.
words.chinese: 商業關係；貿易關係

words.engDef: the ordering of work to be done; also bringing equipment into use
words.example: The company is commissioning a new warehouse to handle the increased volume of orders.
words.chinese: （正式地）委託、授權；（工程項目）啟用、投產

words.engDef: raw materials or farm products that are traded
words.example: The company's profits were significantly impacted by the fluctuating prices of agricultural commodities.
words.chinese: 商品；（可交易的）農產品、礦產或其他原材料。

words.engDef: the parts that make up a machine or product
words.example: The new computer system requires several key components, including a high-performance processor and ample RAM.
words.chinese: 組件；構成要素（指構成某物或系統的各個部分）

words.engDef: presses something into a smaller space
words.example: The packaging department compresses the boxes to save space during shipping.
words.chinese: 壓縮；將…壓緊

words.engDef: the person or company to whom a consignment is sent
words.example: The carrier must obtain the signature of the consignee upon delivering the goods.
words.chinese: 收貨人

words.engDef: a batch of goods delivered to someone on commission to sell
words.example: The publisher sent a large consignment of books to the local bookstore on commission.
words.chinese: 寄售，委託貨物

words.engDef: the person or company that sends a consignment of goods
words.example: The consignor is responsible for ensuring that all shipping documentation is accurate.
words.chinese: 寄件人，發貨人

words.engDef: making a formal agreement; also becoming smaller
words.example: The company is currently contracting with a new supplier to reduce costs.
words.chinese: 簽訂合約；縮減（規模、成本等）

words.engDef: firms or people hired to do work under a contract
words.example: The company hired several contractors to renovate the office building.
words.chinese: 承包商；簽約人員（通常指為公司或組織提供服務或完成專案的獨立人士或公司）

words.engDef: formal written agreements
words.example: The legal department is reviewing the new supply contracts to ensure favorable terms.
words.chinese: 合約；協議（通常指正式的商業或法律文件）

words.engDef: a moving belt that carries goods along
words.example: The factory uses a conveyor belt to move packages from the assembly line to the shipping area.
words.chinese: 輸送帶；傳送帶，用於持續移動物料的裝置。

words.engDef: a building where goods are kept cold
words.example: The perishable goods were transported directly to the coolstore to maintain their freshness.
words.chinese: 冷藏倉庫；冷儲設施，用於儲存需要低溫環境的商品。

words.engDef: a family name
words.example: The supplier confirmed that the shipment of corn arrived on schedule.
words.chinese: 玉米；玉米粒（通常指乾燥或罐裝的玉米，在食品或農業情境中使用）

words.engDef: a calculation of what something is likely to cost
words.example: The project manager requested a cost estimate from several suppliers before making a decision.
words.chinese: 成本估計；預估成本

words.engDef: giving good value for the money spent
words.example: We need to find a cost-effective solution to reduce shipping expenses.
words.chinese: 成本效益高，在投入成本後能產生相對較高的價值或回報。

words.engDef: a different offer made in reply to one received
words.example: After reviewing the initial offer, we submitted a counteroffer with a slightly higher price and extended delivery timeline.
words.chinese: 反要約；對初步提案的回應，通常包含修改後的條件。

words.engDef: printed slips giving a discount on goods
words.example: Employees are encouraged to use the company coupons when purchasing office supplies.
words.chinese: 優惠券；折扣券

words.engDef: a company or person that delivers parcels quickly
words.example: The company uses a reliable courier service to ensure timely delivery of important documents.
words.chinese: 快遞公司；快遞員（指負責快速遞送文件或包裹的人員或公司）

words.engDef: a business that delivers parcels and documents fast
words.example: We use a reliable courier service to ensure timely delivery of our products to clients.
words.chinese: 快遞服務；快遞公司，通常指提供快速、可靠的包裹遞送服務。

words.engDef: companies or people who deliver parcels quickly
words.example: The company relies on reliable couriers to ensure timely delivery of important documents.
words.chinese: 快遞公司或快遞員，負責快速遞送文件或包裹的專業服務。

words.engDef: layers placed over something to protect or hide it
words.example: The shipment requires protective coverings to prevent damage during transit.
words.chinese: 覆蓋物；外殼；包覆層

words.engDef: a large wooden box used for transporting goods
words.example: The shipment of fragile goods arrived in sturdy crates.
words.chinese: 木箱；棧板箱

words.engDef: made specially to fit a particular need
words.example: The company decided to order custom-built shelving units to maximize storage space in the warehouse.
words.chinese: 客製化訂做的；根據特定需求設計或製造的

words.engDef: made specially for one customer
words.example: The company offers custom-made furniture to meet the specific needs of each client.
words.chinese: 客製化訂做的；依照個人需求設計製作的

words.engDef: a person licensed to clear goods through customs for others
words.example: We hired a licensed customs broker to accelerate the importation of raw materials.
words.chinese: 報關行，報關經紀人

words.engDef: harmed so that it no longer works or looks right
words.example: The shipment was significantly damaged during transit, requiring a claim with the carrier.
words.chinese: 損壞的；受損的；已受損壞的物品

words.engDef: business agreements; also special offers
words.example: The company is offering special deals on all winter clothing items.
words.chinese: 交易；協議；（特別指商業上的）優惠方案

words.engDef: having a fault and not working properly
words.example: The quality control department discovered several defective products during the inspection.
words.chinese: 有缺陷的；不合格的；損壞的

words.engDef: faults that stop something working or looking right
words.example: The quality control department identified several defects in the latest batch of products.
words.chinese: 瑕疵；缺點；缺陷（指產品或服務中存在的不足或錯誤）

words.engDef: periods of waiting caused by something happening late
words.example: We apologize for the delays in processing your order due to unforeseen circumstances.
words.chinese: 延遲；延誤

words.engDef: took goods to the place where they were wanted
words.example: The courier company delivered the package to our office this morning.
words.chinese: 送達；交付；傳遞（通常指透過運送或遞送服務）

words.engDef: loads of goods brought to a place
words.example: We expect a significant increase in deliveries during the holiday season.
words.chinese: 交付；送貨（通常指商品或文件）

words.engDef: taking goods to the place where they are wanted
words.example: The courier company is delivering packages to all destinations on time.
words.chinese: 遞送；交付；傳遞（商品、文件等）

words.engDef: takes goods to the place where they are wanted
words.example: The courier company delivers packages promptly and efficiently.
words.chinese: 交付；送達；傳遞（訊息、產品等）

words.engDef: one of the ways goods can be sent to you
words.example: We offer several delivery options, including standard, express, and same-day delivery.
words.chinese: 交付選擇；指商品或服務的送達方式選項。

words.engDef: a charge payable on failure to load or unload within the agreed time
words.example: We incurred demurrage charges because the container remained at the terminal too long.
words.chinese: （貨櫃）滯期費，延滯費

words.engDef: a hollow mark made in a surface by a blow
words.example: The shipping department needs to inspect the delivered goods for any dents or scratches.
words.chinese: 凹痕；損傷（通常指金屬表面）

words.engDef: a building where goods or vehicles are kept
words.example: The company is expanding its distribution network by opening new depots across the country.
words.chinese: 倉庫；儲存站（通常指大型的、用於儲存貨物的設施）

words.engDef: to separate one part from another
words.example: The shipping department needs to detach the labels from the pallets before they are moved to the warehouse.
words.chinese: 分離；拆卸；移除

words.engDef: to make a hole in the ground using a spade
words.example: The construction crew had to dig with a shovel to clear the debris from the site.
words.chinese: 使用鏟子挖掘

words.engDef: a shop that sells goods at lower than usual prices
words.example: Our company is considering sourcing office supplies from a discount store to reduce costs.
words.chinese: 折扣商店，通常販售多樣商品，以較低價格吸引顧客。

words.engDef: sold at less than the usual price
words.example: The company is offering a discounted rate for bulk orders.
words.chinese: 以折扣價出售或提供的；降低價格的

words.engDef: a price lower than the standard one
words.example: We are offering a discounted rate of 15% on bulk orders.
words.chinese: 折扣率；優惠價格

words.engDef: to send off to a destination, or speedy delivery
words.example: The logistics center will dispatch your order within twenty-four hours.
words.chinese: 發貨，派遣，發送

words.engDef: sent goods or people off to a destination
words.example: The company dispatched a team of engineers to address the technical issue at the client's site.
words.chinese: 派遣；調派；發送（通常指人員或物品）

words.engDef: a company that supplies goods to shops
words.example: Our company is seeking a reliable distributor for our new line of eco-friendly products.
words.chinese: 供應商；經銷商（指負責銷售和分銷產品或服務的公司）

words.engDef: the taking of goods straight from sender to customer
words.example: Our company offers door-to-door delivery for all international orders.
words.chinese: 從門到門的送貨服務，通常指將商品直接送到客戶家門。

words.engDef: selling goods abroad at very low prices to win the market
words.example: The company is accused of dumping outdated inventory on the overseas market.
words.chinese: 傾銷（指將商品以低於成本或市場價格大量銷售到其他國家或地區）

words.engDef: a powerful explosive used for blasting
words.example: The construction company used dynamite to clear the rocky terrain for the new highway.
words.chinese: 強力炸藥，通常指硝化甘油炸藥，用於爆破或拆除工程。

words.engDef: a website where people buy and sell goods
words.example: The company decided to list its surplus inventory on eBay to reduce storage costs.
words.chinese: 一個線上拍賣和購物網站，允許個人和企業買賣商品。

words.engDef: not harmful to the environment
words.example: Our company is committed to sourcing eco-friendly packaging materials to reduce our environmental impact.
words.chinese: 對環境友善的；符合環保標準的

words.engDef: an official ban on trade or commercial activity with a particular country
words.example: The government lifted the trade embargo after the peace treaty was ratified.
words.chinese: 貿易禁令，禁運；禁止出入港口

words.engDef: to supply someone with the things they need
words.example: The company is equipping its new warehouse with state-of-the-art automation systems.
words.chinese: 配備； снабжённый; 提供必要的設備或資源

words.engDef: the tools and machines needed for a job
words.example: The company invested heavily in new equipment to improve production efficiency.
words.chinese: 設備、裝備，通常指用於特定目的的工具或機器。

words.engDef: a price that is far too high
words.example: The company refused to pay the exorbitant price charged for the expedited shipping.
words.chinese: 不合理的、過高的價格；遠超過合理或正常的水平。

words.engDef: to make something happen more quickly
words.example: To meet the tight deadline, we need to expedite the shipping process.
words.chinese: 加速處理；加快進程

words.engDef: a company that sells goods to other countries
words.example: Our company is a leading exporter of agricultural products to Southeast Asia.
words.chinese: 出口商；將商品出口到其他國家或地區的公司或個人。

words.engDef: selling goods to other countries
words.example: Our company is expanding its operations by exporting electronics to Southeast Asia.
words.chinese: 將商品或服務銷售到國外；出口

words.engDef: a fast postal service for urgent items
words.example: We need to send these contracts via express mail to ensure they arrive before the deadline.
words.chinese: 特快郵遞服務；快遞郵件（通常指美國郵政特快服務，提供快速且可靠的郵件送達服務）

words.engDef: a price that is set and cannot be changed
words.example: We prefer a fixed-price contract to avoid unexpected cost increases.
words.chinese: 固定價格；預先約定的價格

words.engDef: easily set on fire
words.example: The warehouse manager emphasized that all flammable materials must be stored in designated fire-resistant cabinets.
words.chinese: 易燃的；容易燃燒的，指物質或物品容易被火點燃。

words.engDef: to make something flat
words.example: The packaging department needs to flatten the cardboard boxes to save storage space.
words.chinese: 使變平；壓平；攤平

words.engDef: a person or shop that sells flowers
words.example: The company ordered a large floral arrangement from a local florist for the conference.
words.chinese: 花店業者；花藝師

words.engDef: very thin metal sheet used for wrapping
words.example: The supplier delivered the electronic components wrapped in foil to protect them during shipping.
words.chinese: （包裝）錫箔紙；（比喻）挫敗、阻礙

words.engDef: a business that provides food to shops or restaurants
words.example: Our company is seeking a reliable food supplier to ensure consistent quality and timely delivery.
words.chinese: 食品供應商，指為餐廳、飯店、超市或其他商業機構提供食品原料的廠商。

words.engDef: shoes and boots of all kinds
words.example: The company is sourcing high-quality footwear for its retail stores.
words.chinese: 鞋類；鞋子（泛指）

words.engDef: when buying goods in big quantities
words.example: We offer special financing options for large purchases of our equipment.
words.chinese: 用於大額採購

words.engDef: the buying and selling of goods between countries
words.example: Our company is expanding its foreign trade operations to include markets in Southeast Asia.
words.chinese: 國際貿易，指國家間的商品和服務的買賣。

words.engDef: the remains of a plant or animal preserved in rock
words.example: The company's geological survey team is analyzing the fossils found at the excavation site to determine the region's history.
words.chinese: 化石；（地質學上）古代生物的遺骸或痕跡，常用於研究歷史和演化。

words.engDef: a ship or aircraft that carries goods
words.example: The freighter was loaded with thousands of containers destined for various ports around the world.
words.chinese: 貨輪; 貨船; 運輸機

words.engDef: food preserved by being kept at very low temperature
words.example: Our company specializes in the import and distribution of frozen food products from overseas.
words.chinese: 冷凍食品產品，指經過冷凍處理以延長保存期限的食品。

words.engDef: the fuel used in most cars
words.example: The company is seeking a reliable supplier of gasoline for its fleet of delivery vehicles.
words.chinese: 汽油；汽油燃料

words.engDef: a thick jelly-like substance
words.example: The supplier confirmed that the product contains a stabilizing gel to prevent separation.
words.chinese: 凝膠；果凍狀物質，常用於產品增稠或穩定。

words.engDef: to receive another item in place of a faulty one
words.example: If the product is defective, you can get a replacement free of charge.
words.chinese: 獲得替換品；取得更換品

words.engDef: a voucher that can be exchanged for goods
words.example: As a reward for your loyalty, we'd like to offer you a $50 gift certificate to our online store.
words.chinese: 禮品憑證；購物憑證，可在特定商店或商家使用。

words.engDef: to offer something at a favourable price
words.example: We're hoping the supplier will give a good price on the bulk order.
words.chinese: 提供有競爭力的價格；以合理的價格出售

words.engDef: a name used for international delivery services
words.example: Our company relies on Globalexpress for timely delivery of critical components.
words.chinese: 全球快遞，指提供國際貨運服務的公司或系統。

words.engDef: to visit shops in order to buy things
words.example: The marketing team needs to go shopping for promotional materials before the conference.
words.chinese: 購物；外出選購商品

words.engDef: small units of weight; one thousandth of a kilogram
words.example: The package weighs 2.5 grams, so it qualifies for the discounted shipping rate.
words.chinese: 公克，一種重量單位，常用於測量商品重量。

words.engDef: a shop that sells food and household goods
words.example: The company is negotiating a contract with several grocery stores to distribute our new product line.
words.chinese: 雜貨店；食品超市（通常指提供食品、日用品等商品的零售商店）

words.engDef: to lift or pull something heavy with effort
words.example: The crane operator had to heave the heavy container onto the truck.
words.chinese: （用很大的力氣）舉起、抬起；搬運；（船隻）啟航

words.engDef: weighing more
words.example: The shipping department informed us that the new shipment is considerably heavier than the previous one.
words.chinese: 更重的；重量更大的

words.engDef: goods used in the home, such as pots and utensils
words.example: The company is expanding its product line to include a wider range of housewares.
words.chinese: 家用用品，指廚房、餐廳及其他居家環境中使用的器具、容器及裝飾品。

words.engDef: official permission to bring goods into a country
words.example: Our company needs to obtain an import license before shipping the electronics from Japan.
words.chinese: 進口許可證：政府發放的文件，允許企業從國外進口特定商品。

words.engDef: a company that brings goods in from other countries
words.example: The company is a major importer of electronics from Asia.
words.chinese: 進口商；進口公司

words.engDef: brings goods in from other countries
words.example: Our company imports raw materials from overseas to manufacture our products.
words.chinese: 進口；進貨

words.engDef: in a heap, one on top of another
words.example: The documents were found in a pile on the desk, making it difficult to locate the specific file.
words.chinese: 堆積著，堆疊著（通常指無序的狀態）

words.engDef: available in the shop or warehouse now
words.example: We're pleased to inform you that the item you ordered is currently in stock and will be shipped within 1-2 business days.
words.chinese: 現貨供應；有庫存

words.engDef: kept in a place until it is needed
words.example: The excess inventory is currently in storage until demand increases.
words.chinese: 存放於儲存空間中；暫時儲存

words.engDef: in the envelope whose postage is already paid
words.example: Please return the completed form in the prepaid envelope provided.
words.chinese: 預付郵資信封

words.engDef: being carried from one place to another
words.example: The shipment is currently in transit and is expected to arrive next week.
words.chinese: 運輸中；正在運送途中

words.engDef: not costing much money
words.example: We're looking for an inexpensive supplier of office supplies to reduce costs.
words.chinese: 價格低廉的；經濟實惠的

words.engDef: a person who gives information to others
words.example: The company hired an informant to gather intelligence on its competitors.
words.chinese: 情報提供者；線人（通常指向警方或調查機構提供資訊的人）

words.engDef: the different foods or substances used to make something
words.example: The supplier needs to provide a complete list of ingredients for the new product.
words.chinese: 原料；成分（尤指食物或產品的組成部分）

words.engDef: to look at something carefully to check it
words.example: The quality control department will inspect all incoming shipments before they are stored.
words.chinese: 仔細檢查；檢驗；審查

words.engDef: an official examination to check quality or safety
words.example: The quality control department conducts a thorough inspection of all incoming materials.
words.chinese: 檢查；檢驗；審查（通常指對產品、流程或文件進行系統性的檢查以確保符合標準或規範）

words.engDef: the amount taken in
words.example: The company is increasing its intake of raw materials to meet the rising demand.
words.chinese: （指）攝取量；（指）收入、進口量

words.engDef: individual things in a list or collection
words.example: Please review the list of items to be shipped to our overseas warehouse.
words.chinese: 物品；貨品；（採購或庫存管理中的）項目

words.engDef: arriving exactly when needed and not before
words.example: The supplier delivers the components just in time for assembly.
words.chinese: 準時抵達或送達，在需要時立即可用，通常指在最後一刻。

words.engDef: a family name
words.example: Our company is considering partnering with Karos to streamline our European distribution network.
words.chinese: 卡羅斯（Karos），通常指一家總部位於德國的物流公司，專注於歐洲範圍內的貨物運輸和供應鏈管理。

words.engDef: a place name used as a company name
words.example: Our logistics team is working to optimize the delivery schedule for Kenderton's latest order.
words.chinese: 肯德頓 (Kenderton) 是指一家虛構的國際貿易公司，通常用於商業模擬和案例研究中，代表著一家在供應鏈管理和全球貿易領域的參與者。

words.engDef: units of weight; one thousand grams
words.example: The shipping company requires all packages to be under 20 kilograms to qualify for express delivery.
words.chinese: 公克（重量單位），通常用於衡量貨物、包裹或商品的重量。

words.engDef: pots, pans, and tools used in a kitchen
words.example: The company is sourcing high-quality kitchenware from overseas suppliers.
words.chinese: 廚房用具，泛指廚房所需的各種器具和器皿。

words.engDef: the time between the initiation and completion of a production process
words.example: The factory managed to reduce its lead time from three weeks to ten days.
words.chinese: 交期，前置時間

words.engDef: raising something to a higher position
words.example: The warehouse staff are responsible for the lifting and moving of heavy boxes.
words.chinese: 舉起；提升；搬運

words.engDef: weighing little and easy to carry
words.example: The company is looking for lightweight packaging materials to reduce shipping costs.
words.chinese: 輕便的；重量輕的，通常指易於攜帶或搬運的物品。

words.engDef: to put goods onto a vehicle or container
words.example: The truck will load the pallets onto the delivery vehicle.
words.chinese: 將 A 載到 B 上；將 A 裝載到 B 上

words.engDef: to put goods onto a lorry
words.example: The warehouse staff are responsible for loading the truck with the finished products.
words.chinese: 將貨物裝載到卡車上；將貨物運送至卡車上

words.engDef: the amount of goods carried at one time
words.example: The truck's load size is limited to 10 tons.
words.chinese: 貨物載重；數據量

words.engDef: carrying a large amount of something
words.example: The truck was loaded with boxes of merchandise ready for shipment.
words.chinese: 裝滿的；充滿了（某物），通常指重量、內容物或特徵。

words.engDef: the platform where goods are loaded onto vehicles
words.example: The delivery truck will arrive at the loading dock around 10 AM.
words.chinese: 貨物裝卸區；貨車停靠區

words.engDef: the organising of the movement and storage of goods
words.example: The logistics department will coordinate the shipment of the new product line to all regional warehouses by next Friday.
words.chinese: 物流；指在供應鏈中，對貨物、資訊及相關資源的規劃、執行與控制，以確保產品能在適當的時間、地點和成本下交付。

words.engDef: failing to reach the customer while being sent
words.example: The customer was upset because his order was lost in delivery and he needed it urgently.
words.chinese: 貨物在運送過程中遺失或無法送達，通常指包裹或貨物未能如期送達。

words.engDef: wood cut ready for building
words.example: The construction company ordered a large quantity of lumber for the new project.
words.chinese: 木材；原木（通常指大宗運輸的木材）

words.engDef: sent something by post
words.example: The invoices were mailed to all clients last week.
words.chinese: （信件、包裹等）已寄出；通過郵寄發送

words.engDef: to offer a price for work or goods
words.example: The company decided to make a bid for the construction project.
words.chinese: （在競標或投標中）提出報價；出價

words.engDef: to form a formal agreement with someone
words.example: The company plans to make a contract with a new supplier to reduce costs.
words.chinese: 與...簽訂合約；與...建立契約關係

words.engDef: to take goods to a customer
words.example: The courier will make a delivery to our office tomorrow morning.
words.chinese: 送貨；將貨物運送至指定地點

words.engDef: to buy something
words.example: The company encourages employees to make a purchase from our preferred vendor.
words.chinese: 購買；進行購物

words.engDef: companies that make goods in factories
words.example: The company is seeking new manufacturers to reduce production costs.
words.chinese: 製造商；生產商（指從事產品製造的企業或公司）

words.engDef: a table or stand from which goods are sold in a market
words.example: The company sources unique souvenirs from various market stalls in the local area.
words.chinese: 攤位，市集攤位（通常指在市集或戶外市場上銷售商品的小攤位）

words.engDef: a place or website where goods are bought and sold
words.example: Our company is expanding its presence in the online marketplace to reach a wider customer base.
words.chinese: 市場（指供需交易的場所，尤其指線上交易平台或商業聚集地）

words.engDef: a large shop or trading centre
words.example: Our company has a contract to supply office supplies to several large marts in the region.
words.chinese: 大型超市或購物中心，通常提供多樣化的商品和服務。

words.engDef: the substances from which things are made
words.example: The purchasing department is responsible for sourcing high-quality raw materials.
words.chinese: 原料、材料；（多指）用於生產或建造的物質。

words.engDef: having a dull surface that does not shine
words.example: The marketing team requested a matte finish for the brochures to give a more sophisticated look.
words.chinese: 霧面、不反光的表面

words.engDef: the size or amount found by measuring
words.example: The company's new measurement initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.
words.chinese: 測量

words.engDef: a person who repairs machines and engines
words.example: The company's new mechanic initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.
words.chinese: 機械師

words.engDef: a city in the United States
words.example: Our logistics team is coordinating shipments from the Memphis distribution center.
words.chinese: 孟菲斯（美國田納西州西部城市），通常指位於密西西比河畔的城市，在商務情境中可能指該地的公司、工廠或物流中心。

words.engDef: hard shiny substances such as iron and copper
words.example: The supplier specializes in sourcing high-quality metals for industrial applications.
words.chinese: 金屬材料；金屬製品

words.engDef: units of length; also devices that measure usage
words.example: The warehouse is 50 meters long and 30 meters wide.
words.chinese: 公尺，公制長度單位，常用於測量距離、尺寸等。

words.engDef: relating to the system of measurement based on tens
words.example: The company's new metric initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.
words.chinese: 指標

words.engDef: a family name, also used as a shop name
words.example: Our marketing department is sourcing promotional materials from Michaels for the upcoming trade show.
words.chinese: 邁克爾商店（Michael's），一家主要銷售手工藝品、藝術用品和花卉材料的大型零售連鎖店。

words.engDef: small units of liquid volume; one thousandth of a litre
words.example: The supplier confirmed that each bottle contains 500 milliliters of olive oil.
words.chinese: 毫升，容量單位，常用於液體測量，尤其在食品、飲料、醫藥等行業。

words.engDef: the code that identifies a particular version of a product
words.example: Could you please provide the model number of the printer you're requesting?
words.chinese: 產品型號；產品編號，用於識別特定產品的唯一代碼。

words.engDef: discussing terms in order to reach an agreement
words.example: The purchasing manager is negotiating a lower price with the supplier.
words.chinese: 協商；談判（通常指商業或合同條款）

words.engDef: a family name
words.example: Our procurement department is evaluating Norris drills for increased efficiency.
words.chinese: 諾里斯 (Norris) 通常指 Norris Industries 的品牌名稱，一家生產和銷售工業工具和設備的公司。

words.engDef: things that can be seen and touched
words.example: The warehouse manager needs to inventory all the objects in storage.
words.chinese: 物品、物件；（尤指）具體的事物

words.engDef: at the moment the goods are handed over
words.example: The package is currently on delivery and is expected to arrive tomorrow.
words.chinese: 送貨途中；正在送貨

words.engDef: requests for goods to be supplied; also instructions
words.example: The warehouse is processing a large number of orders today.
words.chinese: 訂單；指示；命令

words.engDef: not available to buy at the moment
words.example: I'm sorry, but this item is currently out of stock and will not be available until next week.
words.chinese: 缺貨；無存貨

words.engDef: a company from outside that supplies a service
words.example: We are currently evaluating several outside providers for our IT support needs.
words.chinese: 外部供應商，指公司外包給的服務或產品供應商。

words.engDef: a service that delivers by the next morning
words.example: We need to ship these documents overnight express to ensure they arrive before the meeting.
words.chinese: 隔夜快遞；通常指在一天內送達的快速郵件或包裹服務。

words.engDef: to charge more than something is worth
words.example: We believe the supplier is overpricing their products compared to the market average.
words.chinese: 定價過高；以過高的價格出售

words.engDef: parcels wrapped for sending; also sets of things offered together
words.example: The shipping department is responsible for handling all incoming and outgoing packages.
words.chinese: 包裹；貨物包裝

words.engDef: the materials used to wrap and protect goods
words.example: The company is looking for a supplier of eco-friendly packaging.
words.chinese: 包裝；包裝材料；（產品）包裝

words.engDef: strong sticky tape used to seal boxes
words.example: We need to order more packing tape for the upcoming shipment.
words.chinese: 封箱膠帶；用於封閉包裹的透明膠帶

words.engDef: flat wooden platforms used for stacking and moving goods
words.example: The warehouse staff are responsible for stacking the pallets neatly and efficiently.
words.chinese: 棧板；托盤（通常指用於運輸貨物的扁平木質或塑膠平台）

words.engDef: likely to go bad quickly unless kept cool
words.example: The company needs to invest in refrigerated trucks to transport perishable goods efficiently.
words.chinese: 易腐爛的；容易變質的（通常指食品或貨物，需要特殊的儲存或運輸條件以保持新鮮度）

words.engDef: a family name
words.example: Our company is considering implementing Peters' inventory management system to reduce warehousing costs.
words.chinese: 彼得斯（Peters）是一家專注於供應鏈管理軟體的公司，提供解決方案以優化庫存、預測需求和提升整體效率。

words.engDef: to collect parcels in person
words.example: The receptionist will pick up the packages from the courier and deliver them to the relevant departments.
words.chinese: （通常指從郵局、快遞公司等）取回包裹；領取貨物

words.engDef: chose or selected; also gathered fruit or goods
words.example: The quality control team picked out the defective products from the shipment.
words.chinese: 揀選；選擇；摘取

words.engDef: single items or parts of a larger whole
words.example: We need to order more replacement parts; we're running low on pieces for the assembly line.
words.chinese: 零件；份數；數量

words.engDef: a number of things lying one on top of another
words.example: The warehouse staff are struggling to manage the growing pile of unsold merchandise.
words.chinese: 堆積物；大量積累的物品

words.engDef: the country or place where goods were made
words.example: The company is committed to sourcing raw materials from sustainable places of origin.
words.chinese: 原產地；產品或服務的來源地。

words.engDef: relating to the sending of letters and parcels
words.example: The company uses a postal service for sending documents to overseas branches.
words.chinese: 郵政的；與郵政相關的

words.engDef: a thick pad used to hold hot pans
words.example: The kitchen staff were instructed to use potholders when handling hot pans to prevent burns.
words.chinese: 隔熱墊；鍋墊

words.engDef: units of weight; also the currency of Britain
words.example: The shipment weighs 50 pounds, so the shipping cost will be higher.
words.chinese: （重量單位）磅，通常指商品重量或貨物重量。

words.engDef: a dry substance made of very fine particles
words.example: The supplier needs to ensure the powdered sugar is free of lumps before shipping.
words.chinese: 細粉；粉末，常用於食品、化妝品或工業原料。

words.engDef: a written statement of what something will cost
words.example: We need to get a price quote from three different suppliers before placing the order.
words.chinese: 報價單；一份列出商品或服務價格的書面文件。

words.engDef: given a particular price
words.example: The supplier priced the goods at a competitive rate to secure the contract.
words.chinese: 以特定價格標示或定價。

words.engDef: the amounts of money charged for goods
words.example: The company is constantly monitoring market prices to ensure competitive pricing.
words.chinese: 價格；(多數)價格

words.engDef: expensive
words.example: The imported machinery is quite pricey, so we need to carefully evaluate its ROI.
words.chinese: 價格昂貴的；高價的

words.engDef: treated by a series of steps to change or preserve it
words.example: The company is shifting towards using more processed foods to reduce costs.
words.chinese: 經過處理的；加工過的（通常指食品或材料，強調經過改進或變更的狀態）

words.engDef: to obtain something, especially with care or effort, for business
words.example: The purchasing department managed to procure high-quality steel at a discount.
words.chinese: 採購，取得

words.engDef: the action of obtaining or procuring something for a firm
words.example: Corporate procurement rules require managers to obtain at least three supplier bids.
words.chinese: 採購，取得

words.engDef: made or grown something
words.example: The factory produced over 1,000 units of the new smartphone last week.
words.chinese: 製造、生產；（產品）產自

words.engDef: the goods a company makes or sells
words.example: Our company offers a wide range of innovative products to meet customer needs.
words.chinese: 產品；商品（指公司或企業所生產或銷售的物品或服務）

words.engDef: a gas used for cooking and heating
words.example: Our company is seeking a reliable supplier of propane for our industrial generators.
words.chinese: 丙烷，一種用於烹飪、加熱和工業用途的氣體燃料。

words.engDef: formal suggestions put forward for consideration
words.example: The marketing team submitted several proposals for the new advertising campaign.
words.chinese: 提案；建議方案（通常為書面形式，用於正式提交給主管或客戶）

words.engDef: a loose garment worn to keep clothes clean
words.example: The warehouse staff are required to wear protective smocks when handling hazardous materials.
words.chinese: 保護性圍裙，通常用於工作場所以保護衣物和身體。

words.engDef: a company that supplies a service
words.example: Our company is seeking a reliable internet provider with competitive pricing.
words.chinese: 供應商；提供者（指提供商品、服務或資訊的對象）

words.engDef: companies that supply services
words.example: Our company is seeking reliable internet service providers.
words.chinese: 供應商；提供者（指提供產品、服務或資訊的機構或個人）

words.engDef: the supplying of something; also a condition in an agreement
words.example: The contract includes a provision for handling unforeseen circumstances.
words.chinese: 供應；備妥；條款；規定

words.engDef: moved something towards you with force
words.example: The shipping department pulled the order records to verify the delivery status.
words.chinese: 拉；牽；提取；拔出（通常指用力或突然的動作）

words.engDef: a machine that moves liquid or gas
words.example: The logistics department needs to order new pumps for the water treatment facility.
words.chinese: （機械、設備）幫浦；（價格、數量等）提升，提高

words.engDef: to buy something
words.example: The company plans to purchase new equipment to improve production efficiency.
words.chinese: 購買；採購

words.engDef: an official document ordering goods from a supplier
words.example: The accounting department needs to verify all purchase orders before processing payments.
words.chinese: 購買訂單：一份正式文件，由買方發出，用於正式要求供應商提供特定商品或服務，並包含數量、價格、交貨日期等詳細資訊。

words.engDef: bought
words.example: The company purchased a new server to improve data processing speed.
words.chinese: 購買；採購

words.engDef: a person or company that buys something
words.example: The purchaser is responsible for inspecting the goods upon delivery.
words.chinese: 採購者；買方；購買人

words.engDef: the things that have been bought
words.example: The company's annual purchases of raw materials totaled over $5 million.
words.chinese: 購買行為；購買品項

words.engDef: the work of buying goods for a company
words.example: The purchasing department is responsible for negotiating contracts with suppliers.
words.chinese: 採購；購買（通常指企業或組織的正式採購流程）

words.engDef: a frame with bars or shelves for holding things
words.example: The warehouse staff are responsible for organizing the inventory on the racks.
words.chinese: 貨架；置物架；堆積物

words.engDef: a sloping surface joining two different levels
words.example: The warehouse is equipped with a loading ramp for efficient truck access.
words.chinese: 斜坡；坡道，通常用於方便無障礙通行或貨物運輸。

words.engDef: the basic substance from which goods are made
words.example: The company is seeking reliable suppliers of raw materials to ensure consistent production.
words.chinese: 原物料；未經加工的材料

words.engDef: already made and available to buy
words.example: To expedite the project, we opted for ready-made components instead of custom-built ones.
words.chinese: 現成的；預製的；無需額外加工或修改即可使用的

words.engDef: to put the parts back together again
words.example: After the shipment arrived damaged, the technicians were assigned to reassemble the equipment.
words.chinese: 重新組裝；將零件重新組合

words.engDef: money paid back after you have paid too much
words.example: The company is offering a $50 rebate on all energy-efficient appliances.
words.chinese: 退款、折扣（通常是購買商品或服務後獲得的），或減少價格。

words.engDef: getting something that is sent or given
words.example: The warehouse is currently receiving a shipment of new inventory.
words.chinese: 接收；收到；正在接收

words.engDef: able to be treated and used again
words.example: Our company is committed to using recyclable packaging materials to reduce environmental impact.
words.chinese: 可回收的；能被重新利用的，符合環保標準的。

words.engDef: made from material that has been used before
words.example: Our company is committed to using recycled paper for all internal documents to reduce our environmental impact.
words.chinese: 再利用的；以回收材料製成的

words.engDef: a postal service that records and tracks an item
words.example: Please send the contract via registered mail to ensure it reaches the client's office.
words.chinese: 掛號信，保證送達的郵件服務，提供追蹤郵件狀態的功能。

words.engDef: to pass something on from one person or place to another
words.example: The shipping company uses a relay system to ensure timely delivery of goods across the country.
words.chinese: 傳遞；接力傳遞；中繼站

words.engDef: the parts that are left after the rest is gone
words.example: The warehouse manager instructed the team to dispose of the remains of the damaged goods.
words.chinese: 剩餘物；遺留物；殘留物

words.engDef: a small remaining piece of something
words.example: The warehouse manager instructed the staff to dispose of the remnants of the outdated inventory.
words.chinese: 殘餘物；遺留物；少量剩餘物

words.engDef: discussed the terms of an agreement again
words.example: Due to the fluctuating market prices, we had to renegotiate the contract with our supplier.
words.chinese: 重新協商；再度談判（合約、條款等）

words.engDef: a new thing or person that takes the place of another
words.example: The defective parts need to be replaced with new ones immediately.
words.chinese: 替換品；替代品；更換

words.engDef: new things or people that take the place of others
words.example: Due to a manufacturing defect, we're offering free replacements for all affected units.
words.chinese: 替換品；替代品；更換品

words.engDef: putting a new thing in the place of an old one
words.example: The company is replacing outdated equipment with newer, more efficient models.
words.chinese: 取代；替換；更換

words.engDef: the act of filling something up again with supplies
words.example: The distribution center coordinates inventory replenishment for all local supermarkets.
words.chinese: 補貨，補給

words.engDef: an exact copy of an object
words.example: The company ordered a replica of the antique vase for display in the showroom.
words.chinese: 仿製品；複製品（通常指高品質的複製品，用於商業用途）

words.engDef: a copy of a work of art or document
words.example: The company is seeking a reliable vendor for the reproduction of marketing materials.
words.chinese: 複製；重製；繁殖（尤指商業產品或文件）

words.engDef: an official written request for supplies
words.example: The department submitted a requisition for new office supplies.
words.chinese: 正式申請或要求（通常指書面文件，用於購買物品或服務）

words.engDef: the small amount left after a process is finished
words.example: The quality control department found traces of residue in the finished product, requiring further investigation.
words.chinese: 殘留物；剩餘物（通常指在某種過程中留下的不純物或未反應的物質）

words.engDef: goods sent back to the seller; also profits from investment
words.example: The supplier needs to return the defective goods immediately.
words.chinese: 歸還；返回；（貨物）退回

words.engDef: small amounts given to show what a product is like
words.example: The quality control department needs to examine the samples before approving the shipment.
words.chinese: 樣品；樣本；試用品

words.engDef: tools that smooth surfaces by rubbing; also a family name
words.example: The maintenance team needs to order new sanders for the workshop.
words.chinese: 研磨機；砂輪機（通常指用於加工材料的機械設備）

words.engDef: owned or used by someone else before
words.example: The company is considering purchasing secondhand office furniture to reduce costs.
words.chinese: 二手貨；曾被使用過的物品

words.engDef: the small parts of a plant from which new plants grow
words.example: The agricultural company is investing in research to develop new, high-yield seeds.
words.chinese: 種子；（比喻）潛在的機會或資源

words.engDef: a load of goods sent together
words.example: The company is expecting a large shipment of raw materials next week.
words.chinese: 一批貨物的裝運；出貨

words.engDef: loads of goods sent together
words.example: We expect the shipments of raw materials to arrive next week.
words.chinese: 貨物一批；一批出貨物

words.engDef: sent goods to a customer or place
words.example: The order has been shipped and should arrive within three business days.
words.chinese: （商品）已寄出；運送

words.engDef: a person or company that sends or transports goods
words.example: The shipper agreed to use eco-friendly packaging materials for all deliveries.
words.chinese: 託運人，發貨商

words.engDef: the sending of goods from one place to another
words.example: The shipping cost for this order is $25.
words.chinese: 指商品或貨物的運輸、運送過程，通常涉及貨運公司或物流服務。

words.engDef: the charge for sending and packing goods
words.example: The total cost includes the price of the product plus shipping and handling.
words.chinese: 運費及包裝處理費，指商品運送及包裝所需的費用。

words.engDef: a name used for a supplier
words.example: Our company is seeking reliable shondaroths for raw materials.
words.chinese: 供應商；提供者（通常指提供商品或服務的對象）

words.engDef: a person who is buying things in shops
words.example: The store is offering a discount to attract more shoppers during the holiday season.
words.chinese: 購物者；顧客（指在商店或市場中購買商品的人）

words.engDef: the activity of buying goods in shops
words.example: The company is planning a bulk shopping trip to reduce operational costs.
words.chinese: 購物；採購（指購買商品，通常涉及商業交易）

words.engDef: to pass through a sieve; also to examine carefully
words.example: The quality control department will sift through the returned products to identify defective items.
words.chinese: 篩選；仔細檢查以找出特定項目

words.engDef: to write your name on an agreement to make it binding
words.example: The company needs to sign a contract with the supplier before placing the order.
words.chinese: 簽訂合約；正式同意並記錄一份協議。

words.engDef: a visit to a place to check conditions or progress
words.example: Before finalizing the contract, the purchasing manager insisted on a thorough site inspection.
words.chinese: 現場勘查；實地考察（通常指在採購、建設或合約履行過程中進行的現場檢查）

words.engDef: made in a particular size
words.example: The company needs shirts sized according to the employee's measurements.
words.chinese: 根據尺寸；以...為尺寸

words.engDef: to break something violently into pieces
words.example: The shipping company is liable for damages if the fragile goods are smashed during transit.
words.chinese: 猛烈撞擊；粉碎；打破

words.engDef: wood from trees such as pine, easy to cut and shape
words.example: The construction company prefers to use softwood for the interior framing due to its lower cost and ease of installation.
words.chinese: 軟木材，通常指容易加工的木材，如松木、杉木等，廣泛應用於建築、家具等產業。

words.engDef: a person or machine that separates items into groups
words.example: The automated sorter efficiently directs packages to the correct delivery routes.
words.chinese: 分類者；分揀機（用於處理大量資料或物品）

words.engDef: people or machines that separate items into groups
words.example: The warehouse needs more sorters to handle the increased volume of packages.
words.chinese: 分類人員；分揀員（通常指在物流或郵件處理中使用於分類物品的人員）

words.engDef: a detailed description of how something must be made
words.example: The supplier needs to adhere to the product specifications outlined in the contract.
words.chinese: 規格、規範；詳細說明（通常指產品、服務或程序的詳細要求）

words.engDef: detailed descriptions of the required design or quality
words.example: The supplier must adhere to all the product specifications outlined in the contract.
words.chinese: 規格；規格說明；技術規範

words.engDef: coiled pieces of metal that return to shape; also water sources
words.example: The supplier assured us that the new suspension springs would improve the truck's handling.
words.chinese: 彈簧；泉水；（某事物突然）出現、發生

words.engDef: placing things one on top of another
words.example: The warehouse staff are stacking boxes to maximize storage space.
words.chinese: 堆疊；疊放；累積（數量或資料）

words.engDef: a person employed at a dock to load and unload cargo from ships
words.example: The experienced stevedores worked efficiently to unload the container ship.
words.chinese: 碼頭工人

words.engDef: an event that causes inventory of an item to be completely exhausted
words.example: The retail chain suffered a severe stockout of its bestselling winter jackets.
words.chinese: 缺貨

words.engDef: building up a large store of goods for later use
words.example: The company is stockpiling raw materials in anticipation of a supply chain disruption.
words.chinese: 大量積存；囤積（通常指為了應對未來需求或價格波動）

words.engDef: the keeping of goods until they are needed
words.example: The warehouse has ample storage for the incoming shipment.
words.chinese: 儲存空間；存放

words.engDef: a closed space used for keeping things
words.example: The delivery team needs to ensure that all fragile items are properly secured in the storage compartment of the truck.
words.chinese: 儲物隔間；存放空間（通常指車輛、家具等內部的空間）

words.engDef: a building where goods are kept
words.example: Our company is looking for a reliable storage facility to handle the excess inventory.
words.chinese: 儲存設施，通常指商業用途的倉儲空間，用於存放貨物、文件或其他物品。

words.engDef: shops; also keeps things for later use
words.example: The company is expanding its retail presence by opening new stores in major cities.
words.chinese: 商店；零售店

words.engDef: a narrow band used to fasten or carry something
words.example: The shipping department needs to secure the pallets with sturdy straps to prevent damage during transit.
words.chinese: 帶子；固定帶；繫帶

words.engDef: a particular type of material
words.example: The lab technician analyzed the substance to determine its chemical composition.
words.chinese: 物質；成分；內容；主題

words.engDef: provided goods or services to someone
words.example: The company is supplied with raw materials from overseas.
words.chinese: 供應；提供（資源、資訊等）

words.engDef: a company that provides goods to another business
words.example: Our company is seeking reliable suppliers for raw materials.
words.chinese: 供應商，提供商品或服務的廠商

words.engDef: companies that provide goods to other businesses
words.example: We are currently seeking new suppliers for raw materials to reduce costs.
words.chinese: 供應商；提供商品或服務的廠商

words.engDef: the whole system that moves goods from maker to customer
words.example: The company is working to optimize its supply chain to reduce costs and improve efficiency.
words.chinese: 供應鏈：指從原材料採購到最終產品交付給客戶的整個流程，包含所有參與的機構和活動。

words.engDef: an amount left over after needs are met
words.example: The company reported a significant surplus at the end of the fiscal year.
words.chinese: 剩餘；盈餘；超出額度

words.engDef: to count and record all the goods in stock
words.example: Before the holiday sale, the warehouse manager needs to take inventory of all products.
words.chinese: 盤點庫存；清點現有資源（通常指商品、設備或人力）

words.engDef: large containers for holding liquid or gas
words.example: The logistics team is responsible for ensuring the tanks are properly sealed and transported.
words.chinese: 儲水槽；油罐；（軍事上）坦克

words.engDef: a tax charged on goods coming into a country
words.example: The company's new tariff initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.
words.chinese: 關稅

words.engDef: to become unfrozen
words.example: The shipment of frozen goods will thaw during transit if the temperature control system fails.
words.chinese: 融化；解凍

words.engDef: a person or firm not directly involved in an agreement
words.example: The contract stipulates that a third party will be responsible for quality control.
words.chinese: 第三方；不參與原來的關係或協議的個人或實體。

words.engDef: sending something through the air with your hand
words.example: The warehouse staff are responsible for throwing away damaged goods.
words.chinese: 拋擲；丟棄；（物品）被丟棄的狀態

words.engDef: a female first name
words.example: The logistics team is using the latest Tina report to optimize warehouse storage.
words.chinese: 縮寫，通常指 Tina，代表 Total Inventory Assessment，全盤庫存評估，用於衡量庫存管理效率。

words.engDef: a metric unit of weight equal to one thousand kilograms
words.example: The ship can carry up to 10,000 tonnes of cargo.
words.chinese: 公噸（國際計量單位，等於1000公斤）

words.engDef: of the best quality in a range of products
words.example: Our company only purchases top-of-the-line equipment to ensure the highest quality of our products.
words.chinese: 頂級的；最優質的；高品質的（通常指產品或服務）

words.engDef: following the progress or position of something
words.example: The company's new tracking initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.
words.chinese: 追蹤

words.engDef: a beginning meaning across or through
words.example: The logistics company specializes in transferring goods across international borders.
words.chinese: 傳輸；跨越；超過

words.engDef: to carry goods or people from one place to another
words.example: The logistics department is responsible for the safe transport of goods to our overseas branches.
words.chinese: 運輸；運送（貨物、人員等）

words.engDef: able to be carried from place to place
words.example: The company is looking for transportable storage units to accommodate fluctuating inventory levels.
words.chinese: 可攜帶的；易於搬運的

words.engDef: carrying goods or people from place to place
words.example: The logistics company is responsible for transporting goods from the factory to the distribution center.
words.chinese: 運輸；運送（貨物、人員等）

words.engDef: a yellow spice used in cooking
words.example: Our supplier is exploring sustainable sourcing options for turmeric to meet increasing customer demand.
words.chinese: 薑黃，一種常用的香料，因其獨特的色澤和健康益處，常被用於食品和保健產品。

words.engDef: to take goods off a vehicle
words.example: The truck will unload the shipment at the warehouse tomorrow morning.
words.chinese: 卸貨；將貨物從運輸工具上卸下

words.engDef: to take things out of a box or case
words.example: The shipping department will unpack the new inventory upon arrival.
words.chinese: 卸貨；拆開行李箱

words.engDef: the name of a large parcel delivery company
words.example: We're using UPS to ship the samples to our overseas clients.
words.chinese: （UPS）聯合包裹服務，全球知名的快遞公司。

words.engDef: machines such as cars and lorries used to carry people or goods
words.example: The company is investing in a fleet of electric vehicles to reduce its carbon footprint.
words.chinese: 車輛；交通工具（指用於運輸人員或貨物的各種車輛）

words.engDef: people or companies that sell goods
words.example: The purchasing department is currently evaluating several vendors for the new office supplies.
words.chinese: 供應商；銷售商（通常指批量供應商品或服務的公司）

words.engDef: cleaning something with water
words.example: The laundry service includes washing, drying, and folding all garments.
words.chinese: 清洗；洗濯；洗衣

words.engDef: able to keep out water to some degree
words.example: The company requires all shipping containers to be water-resistant to protect the goods during transit.
words.chinese: 具防水性能的；能抵抗水的侵蝕的

words.engDef: a river or canal along which boats can travel
words.example: The company is exploring alternative waterways to reduce shipping costs and avoid potential port congestion.
words.chinese: 水道；航道，水路運輸路線

words.engDef: a document issued by a carrier giving shipment details
words.example: The customs officer examined the waybill to verify the contents of the crates.
words.chinese: 貨運單，運單

words.engDef: the greatest weight that is allowed
words.example: Please check the weight limit for each package before shipping to avoid extra charges.
words.chinese: 最大承載重量；允許的重量限制

words.engDef: accommodation at a wharf, or the fee charged for its use
words.example: The logistics firm received a bill for wharfage after the ship stayed at the dock.
words.chinese: 碼頭使用費

words.engDef: a small cart with one wheel used to carry loads
words.example: The warehouse staff used wheelbarrows to move the heavy boxes.
words.chinese: 一輪手推車；用於搬運貨物的工具車

words.engDef: having wheels
words.example: The warehouse is equipped with wheeled forklifts to efficiently move pallets.
words.chinese: 具備輪子的；裝有輪子的

words.engDef: vehicles or people described by the number of wheels
words.example: Our company is seeking reliable wheelers to supply tires for our fleet vehicles.
words.chinese: 輪胎供應商；輪胎銷售商（通常指大型或知名企業）

words.engDef: the round parts that turn to move a vehicle
words.example: The company is sourcing new wheels for the delivery trucks to ensure smooth operations.
words.chinese: 車輪；輪子（通常指交通工具的輪子，或指相關的運輸系統）

words.engDef: to be chosen to do work under an agreement
words.example: Our company is hoping to win a contract with the government.
words.chinese: 贏得合約；獲得合約

words.engDef: covering something in paper or other material
words.example: The shipping department is responsible for the wrapping and labeling of all outgoing packages.
words.chinese: 包裝；包裹；包覆

words.engDef: a male first name, short for Zachary
words.example: The warehouse manager instructed the team to sort through the zacs of fabric and identify usable pieces.
words.chinese: 零碎、小片；（尤指）剩餘的材料或零件
